body_markdown:
Wrapped season is almost here! We want to make sure you get everything you can out of the experience. Here are a few simple ways to get your Spotify ready before the big reveal.


## **Update your Spotify app**


Check your device’s app store to see if an update is available, so you’re ready to dive into Wrapped when it arrives.


## **Choose what shapes your Wrapped**


Whether it’s a calming sleep sound or a one-off listen that doesn’t fit your usual vibe, not every song you listen to reflects your overall taste. With that in mind, you can


[exclude individual tracks and playlists](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-01/exclude-tracks-taste-profile/) from your taste profile. That way, they won’t influence your Wrapped results (or your day-to-day recommendations), whether you listened to them in the past or stream them in the future.


Choose a track or playlist, tap the three dots, and select


**Exclude from your taste profile** . Changed your mind? Just select


**Include in your taste profile** to add it back.


## **Manage kids and family music**


Love listening to music together as a family? Now you can decide whether those streams shape your recommendations (and influence your Wrapped) with a


[dedicated toggle](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-09-15/exclude-kids-family-music-toggle/) . When you toggle off, you can still search for and listen to kids and family music as usual, but those streams won’t count toward your Wrapped top songs or artists.


To turn it off on mobile, tap your profile picture, open


**Settings and privacy** , choose


**Content and display** , then switch off the toggle next to


**Include kids and family music in taste profile** .
